name: Nextcloud
description: Your own cloud: files, calendar, contacts and more.
notes: The first visit asks for an admin account; the built-in SQLite database is fine for a few people.
compose:
services:
  nextcloud:
    image: nextcloud:latest
    container_name: nextcloud
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:80"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/html:/var/www/html
